drafts.title: Comply with Owner Safety Rules and OSHA
drafts.requirement_text: Contractor shall comply with the Owner's Contractor Safety Rules and with OSHA 29 CFR 1926; the more stringent governs.
drafts.quote: Contractor shall comply with the Owner's Contractor Safety Rules and with OSHA 29 CFR 1926; the more stringent governs.

drafts.title: Wear Owner-issued construction badge
drafts.requirement_text: All contractor personnel shall wear an Owner-issued construction badge while on the campus.
drafts.quote: All contractor personnel shall wear an Owner-issued construction badge while on the campus.

drafts.title: No crane loads over occupied building
drafts.requirement_text: No crane load shall pass over any occupied building. Loads over an unoccupied portion require an Owner-approved lift plan and a cleared zone.
drafts.quote: No crane load shall pass over any occupied building. Loads over an unoccupied portion require an Owner-approved lift plan and a cleared zone.

drafts.title: Subcontractor EMR maximum 1.10
drafts.requirement_text: Contractor subcontractors shall have an EMR of 1.10 or less; exceptions require written Owner approval.
drafts.quote: Contractor subcontractors shall have an EMR of 1.10 or less; exceptions require written Owner approval.

drafts.title: Utility shutdown request 14 calendar days
drafts.requirement_text: Utility shutdowns affecting the hospital require a Utility Shutdown Request submitted 14 calendar days in advance and approved by the Director of Facilities & Construction.
drafts.quote: Utility shutdowns affecting the hospital require a Utility Shutdown Request submitted 14 calendar days in advance and approved by the Director of Facilities & Construction.

drafts.title: Fire/sprinkler impairment requires notice and ILSM
drafts.requirement_text: Any impairment of fire alarm, sprinkler or smoke control systems requires an Owner-approved impairment notice and interim life safety measures (ILSM) per The Joint Commission LS.01.02.01 and NFPA 101.
drafts.quote: Any impairment of fire alarm, sprinkler or smoke control systems requires an Owner-approved impairment notice and interim life safety measures (ILSM) per The Joint Commission LS.01.02.01 and NFPA 101.

drafts.title: Noise limits and vibration work notice
drafts.requirement_text: Noise at the nearest occupied patient room shall not exceed 70 dBA between 07:00 and 19:00 and 55 dBA at other times; vibration-generating work next to surgery requires 48 hours' notice.
drafts.quote: Noise at the nearest occupied patient room shall not exceed 70 dBA between 07:00 and 19:00 and 55 dBA at other times; vibration-generating work next to surgery requires 48 hours' notice.

drafts.title: Emergency exits and fire lanes unobstructed
drafts.requirement_text: Emergency exits, ambulance routes and fire lanes shall remain unobstructed at all times.
drafts.quote: Emergency exits, ambulance routes and fire lanes shall remain unobstructed at all times.

drafts.title: Report injury/near miss within 2 hours
drafts.requirement_text: The Contractor shall report any injury or near miss on the campus to the Owner's Safety Officer within 2 hours.
drafts.quote: The Contractor shall report any injury or near miss on the campus to the Owner's Safety Officer within 2 hours.

drafts.title: ICRA with ASHE matrix and permit
drafts.requirement_text: An Infection Control Risk Assessment (ICRA) shall be completed with the Owner's Infection Prevention department for each area of work, using the ASHE ICRA 2.0 matrix, and an ICRA permit issued before work begins.
drafts.quote: An Infection Control Risk Assessment (ICRA) shall be completed with the Owner's Infection Prevention department for each area of work, using the ASHE ICRA 2.0 matrix, and an ICRA permit issued before work begins.

drafts.title: Class III/IV barriers, negative pressure, HEPA
drafts.requirement_text: Class III and IV: rigid barriers from floor to deck, sealed; negative pressure of at least -0.01 in. w.c. continuously monitored with an alarmed manometer and recorded daily; HEPA filtration of exhaust.
drafts.quote: Class III and IV: rigid barriers from floor to deck, sealed; negative pressure of at least -0.01 in. w.c. continuously monitored with an alarmed manometer and recorded daily; HEPA filtration of exhaust.

drafts.title: Class IV anteroom and protective clothing
drafts.requirement_text: Class IV: an anteroom is required; workers wear shoe covers and coveralls that are removed on exit.
drafts.quote: Class IV: an anteroom is required; workers wear shoe covers and coveralls that are removed on exit.

drafts.title: Barrier inspection and breach protocol
drafts.requirement_text: Barriers shall be inspected daily by the Contractor and weekly by Infection Prevention. Any breach shall stop work until repaired and re-inspected.
drafts.quote: Barriers shall be inspected daily by the Contractor and weekly by Infection Prevention. Any breach shall stop work until repaired and re-inspected.

drafts.title: Debris removal in covered carts
drafts.requirement_text: Debris shall be removed in covered carts by designated routes and times approved by the Owner.
drafts.quote: Debris shall be removed in covered carts by designated routes and times approved by the Owner.
